purpose: Reconcile recorded charging, driving, inferred standby drain and stored pack energy by month, exposing unexplained residuals.
primaryGoal: Understand where charged energy went and how complete the available history is without mistaking missing evidence for measured zero.

routeEvidence.detail: Lazy import points to assigned page.
energy-ledger route mounts EnergyLedger through SafeRoute; actual runtime mount unverified.

dataSources.ownership: Charging hook -> internal\handler\v1\charging_handler.go:30 -> internal\app\chargingsvc\service.go:81 -> charging repository port.
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:5037 registers the handler; internal\handler\v1\charging_handler.go:25 declares GET /charging-sessions.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-required, AbortSignal forwarded, safeArray selector, vehicle-specific query key, inherited retry policy. Handler accepts vehicle_id and delegates without range arguments.
dataSources.contractRisk: Returned domain charging fields are not the typed fields read by energyLedger; see architecture finding EL-001. Repository completeness and actual network payload were not exercised.

dataSources.ownership: Driving hook and drives handler registered in internal\api\router.go:3463-3464.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-required, AbortSignal forwarded, safeArray selector, FAST staleTime, optional server start/end/limit contract. Page supplies none of those options.
dataSources.contractRisk: DriveWindow documentation at useDriving.ts:85-88 explicitly identifies the default 50-row page; exact live server completeness is unverified.

dataSources.ownership: Existing selected-vehicle store and URL workspace owner; useVehicles.ts:73-76.
dataSources.behavior: URL/store/fleet fallback selection; page does not create a competing selector. Full provider and authentication graph are outside this bounded audit.

dataSources.ownership: Existing preference formatter, URL hidden-series state, and pure battery ledger calculation.
dataSources.behavior: SI Wh/W/m stay in summary; page derives kWh chart display values. Months use browser-local Date getters; pack estimate is median of plausible wide-SoC sessions.

components.contract: Existing min-w-0 full-width container, named data sources, query freshness and shell-owned workspace.

components.contract: StatMetric -> useOperationalMetrics; loading/retained evidence, unknown period reason, review drawer; no replacement KPI pipeline.

components.contract: Canonical frame, toolbar/export, chartKey, accessible data table, loading/error/empty, responsive sizing.

components.name: LayoutCard / Text / Badge / HelpTooltip
components.contract: Named cards, semantic typography and severity; method explanation stays reachable.

components.name: SourceContent / StaleRefreshWarning
components.contract: Fatal recovery is local; retained payloads survive refresh failure; independent retries.

components.name: NoVehicleSelected / FadeIn
components.contract: Existing onboarding recovery; FadeIn respects reduced motion and low bandwidth through useMotionPreference.

observations.detail: Four local label/value pairs render month details; use existing typography and local month component if extracted. No second production consumer was inspected to justify a new shared component.
Two percentage formatter callbacks and closure thresholds repeat locally; preserve rounding and semantics if consolidated.

responsive.status: source-only; all ten specified widths unverified
responsive.observed: Shared width/min-w-0 frames; details use lg:grid-cols-2, inner pairs use grid-cols-2 and sm:grid-cols-4, month header wraps. Chart ResponsiveContainer fills a fixed 380px frame.

issues.detail: Month-detail grid and chart at 320px, long translations, increased text size and many months have no mounted evidence; source lacks local break-word/min-w-0 safeguards on each numeric value.
issues.fix: Exercise allocated-width and long-label cases before changing layout; retain every detail and chart/table/export capability. Add only demonstrated local wrapping fixes.

accessibility.status: keyboard, focus, assistive technology, contrast and forced colors unverified
accessibility.observed: Shared page focus heading; chart ariaLabel and six fallback data columns; semantic ul/li months; text labels accompany severity badges; meaningful help ariaLabel; summary context icons aria-hidden. Shared chart fallback remains present and exposes forced-colors table.

issues.detail: Chart ticks hardcode 10px and 11px font sizes rather than deriving from shared typography/preference policy. Legibility under font scaling is unverified.
issues.fix: Reuse existing canonical chart typography policy; retain axes, signed values and accessible fallback. Validate composed labels and contrast rather than claiming token names prove accessibility.

states.initialLoading: Brief loading, ChartCard loading and 180px detail skeleton; page-level loading/busy props are not passed.
states.empty: Monthly card and detail card explain missing history; summary nevertheless emits numeric zeros once both queries resolve empty.
states.fatalError: KPI-only SourceContent supplies retry of failed sources; chart and month detail do not receive fatal error.
states.refreshFailure: Two StaleRefreshWarning instances preserve retained rows and provide independent retries; Brief marks retained status.
states.offline: Shared warnings distinguish paused retained queries; paused initial query has no retained payload and isLoading can be false.
states.partial: Not explicitly modeled for successful-empty source or missing pack/SoC; derived summary substitutes [] and zero values.

issues.detail: summaryReady means only not-loading/not-fatal; two successful empty arrays yield 0% closure, 0% driving, zero drain and zero unexplained energy as available readings. Initial offline/paused requests can similarly pass this predicate because readiness does not require resolved data.
issues.fix: Derive eligibility from resolved source states and evidential prerequisites; keep unresolved/empty metrics null with source-specific reasons and paused recovery, distinguish genuine measured zero.

issues.detail: Fatal errors are sent only to KPI SourceContent at line 153. Chart has loading/empty but no error/onRetry; details at line 255 ignore isError. One failed source can therefore produce a seemingly valid chart/month list from the other source or a no-months empty message rather than unavailable evidence.
issues.fix: Use existing SourceContent/ChartCard error and retry contracts for reconciliation-dependent sections; retain healthy source data but clearly mark the derived ledger incomplete and do not imply balanced complete books.

issues.detail: Missing pack capacity or endpoint SoC becomes storedDeltaWh=0; unknown drive energy becomes zero at line 214 and charge energy at line 197. No qualifying idle gaps yield vampireWhPerDay=0 at line 365. Page can present inferred/unavailable quantities as numeric evidence.
issues.fix: Integration owner must establish completeness/prerequisite metadata for derived values and preserve known totals separately. Page renders unknown/null and explains missing evidence without silently changing business accounting formulas.

visualIssues.detail: Percent and drain callbacks embed Math.round/raw ASCII units; monthly YYYY-MM keys come from browser-local monthKey, rather than saved timezone and centralized locale formatting. Actual display preferences are only partially used despite useUnits for energy/power/distance.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing locale/metric formatter and timezone policy at display boundary, preserving signed residual, Wh/day meaning, precision and raw SI. Do not convert cached inputs or invent a second formatter.

architectureIssues.detail: Hook asserts ChargingSession[] with started_at, start_soc_pct, total_energy_added_wh. Registered /charging-sessions handler returns domain ChargingSession through chargingsvc; internal/domain/charging/types.go:12-22 emits startBatteryLevel, endBatteryLevel, energyAddedWh, startedAt and completedAt. Ledger reads started_at ?? start_ts (energyLedger.ts:184), never startedAt; energy and SoC fields also differ. The inspected client only applies camelCaseKeys, not a documented semantic alias remap. Thus source contracts disagree even though route exists; live serialization remains unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner aligns canonical SI response and typed charging hook, or chooses the already-existing compatible charging source after verifying its exact contract. No legacy unit fields or temporary dual-source accounting; retain every row/identity and explain source window.

architectureIssues.detail: Dated monthly analysis uses unbounded charging hook and default-page drives hook with no useRangeState. workspaceScope.ts:23-77 omits /energy-ledger, so header range is disabled. Unknown-period copy at lines 151-152 acknowledges bounds, but does not provide workspace range or solve asymmetric input windows.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner registers dated route and supplies both header-owned instant bounds through compatible typed hooks, verifying server filtering and calendar/rolling/timezone semantics. Ledger needs explicitly documented boundary context for gaps/pack calibration; no local duplicate picker or client-only page filtering.

priority.reason: Source shape and evidence integrity precede cosmetic modernization. Current page already uses canonical frames and restrained surface/text tokens.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical charging source contract alignment
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Typed canonical SI energy/SoC/start/end fields matching actual GET payload; AbortSignal, vehicle key, null/partial provenance and source-window metadata preserved. Existing selector must not silently lose domain fields.
requiredSharedChanges.action: Resolve contract mismatch; this audit does not authorize shared edits or claim impact on uninspected callers.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Header-owned ledger date scope
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Register /energy-ledger in RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS; typed start/end server bounds for charging and drives; preserve rolling/custom/DST/timezone, vehicle, source keys and cancellations; disclose observed completeness.
requiredSharedChanges.action: Scoped integration requirement, not a competing range component.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Derived ledger evidence prerequisites
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Expose which capacity/SoC/energy/gap inputs are known and complete without converting SI or altering accounting silently; map missing and incomplete derived values to existing StatMetric/DataState contracts.
requiredSharedChanges.action: Feature data-contract correction; existing shared presentation APIs suffice, no new global component proposed.

competingImplementations.notes: Page uses category barrels and existing ledger/brief/frame/query/formatter owners. Local month cards do not establish a competing library. Shared alternative sources useChargingHistory/useDriveHistory exist but must not be adopted as a completeness guarantee.

preservation.countExplanation: Two LayoutCard callsites include the alternative monthly empty shell; three logical sections remain. ChartCard forwards to canonical ChartContainer. No section was removed and no source change was made.
dataBehavior: median capacity from >=20 percentage-point charging spans within plausible pack bounds
idle gap bounds 0.5 hours through 14 days and 2000W maximum
all stored-energy accessible/export evidence even though not plotted
preservation.prohibitedLoss: No deletion of specialist help, chart columns, controls, source identities, preferences or month details; no fabricated measurements, recalculation shortcuts, legacy SI aliases or new palette.
